docs.title: Context
docs.text: I used Git and GitHub to manage a small project containing example RNA-seq sample metadata. The aim was to learn how version control helps track changes and organise bioinformatics work.

docs.title: My Contribution
docs.text: I created a repository, recorded changes with commits, and pushed my work to GitHub. I also worked with branches, merged a pull request, resolved a merge conflict, and configured .gitignore to exclude example pipeline outputs.

docs.title: Outcome
docs.text:
This practical gave me introductory experience with a Git workflow that I can apply to future coding projects. I learned how to inspect changes, maintain a clear project history, and manage conflicting edits without losing track of earlier work.
